h1: Steel Storage Tank Fabrication in Pakistan: Welded Tanks Made to Your Size
quickAnswer: A steel storage tank is a welded container for liquids or bulk goods. Steel Mind fabricates tanks to your size, with inspected welds, openings in the right places and a coating suited to the contents.
alt: Welded cylindrical steel storage tank on a concrete base.

faq.q: What details are needed to quote a tank?
faq.a: Send the capacity, the contents, the working temperature, the site and any connections you need.

faq.q: Can the tank be delivered in parts?
faq.a: Large tanks can be made in sections, transported and joined on site.

blocks.text: Steel Mind fabricates welded steel tanks for water, oil, feed and other bulk goods. The size, shape and plate thickness follow your drawing and the nature of the contents.

The stored material decides the steel grade, the plate thickness and the coating. Round tanks use less steel, while rectangular tanks fit tight spaces. Tank welds must be tight and clean, so they are inspected before painting. The drawing places manholes, pipe connections, vents and ladders. The foundation must carry the full weight of the filled tank. Inside and outside coatings protect against rust and against the stored product.
Dairy and food plants, factories, farms, construction sites and municipal facilities.
